snippet.title: Nox Mortalis - Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819690/Nox_Mortalis_Demo

Composed by: https://www.youtube.com/@Heromhqd
